description: Grade the artifacts scout produced when seeding a project (the .agents/* docs + CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md). One reviewable list — edit/extend freely.

criteria.question: Do the seeded docs correctly identify the test framework AND the exact command to run tests?
Is the package manager identified correctly (matches the repo)?
Do the docs describe the app under test — structure, key surfaces, and locator/testid conventions?
Is a (light) way-of-work / team workflow captured?
Are per-role memory briefings present and relevant to each role's job?
Are the facts accurate — no fabricated or contradictory claims (e.g. wrong package manager, a framework that isn't there)?
Could a downstream agent start work using ONLY these docs (commands, paths, conventions are concrete, not vague)?
